subject: Derailment playbook — MAP & evaluation timeline breach
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP adjustment request — evaluation milestones slipping

Hi Sarah —

Quick note after this morning's internal sync. It looks like Acme's security review and procurement hold are going to push the evaluation milestones beyond the MAP dates we agreed on (target close 2027-08-21). To keep this from turning into a surprise escalation for both teams, I propose we: 

- Re-baseline the MAP with new hard milestone dates (see attached MAP_v4.xlsx).
- Shortlist a minimal evaluation scope (redline in evaluation-plan.pdf) we can complete while procurement finishes the PO.
- Schedule an executive check-in (15m) the week of Aug 9 to confirm the re-baselined close path.

What I need from you: one consolidated expected date from procurement (best effort) and a note if security can provide SOC2 evidence or an ETA. If we can get those by COB Tue (Aug 3) we'll avoid a formal escalation.

Attachments: MAP_v4.xlsx, evaluation-plan.pdf

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP adjustment request — evaluation milestones slipping

Ava —

Thanks for the heads up and for putting the attachment together. Short version: procurement is prioritizing a new vendor review this week and security asked for SOC2 evidence plus architecture diagrams. We can share a rough procurement ETA but it won't be a firm PO until the review completes.

Proposed immediate actions from our side:
- I'll share a procurement ETA by EOD Tue (Aug 3).
- Security will try to provide SOC2 evidence and architecture notes by Thu (Aug 5) — I cannot promise earlier.

If you can push a narrowed evaluation scope (as you suggested) that would help the engineering team keep working on a subset.

Attached: procurement_ack.pdf (internal note)

Sarah Liu
Director, AI Platforms | Acme Corporation
sarah.liu@acme.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP adjustment request — internal risk log update

Ava / Diego —

Updating the internal risk log for the Acme deal. Key points and immediate mitigations: 

Risk: Procurement/security delay -> close slips beyond Aug 21 (high likelihood).
Impact: Q3 revenue push; gating of pilot telemetry.
Mitigations proposed:
  1) Offer a reduced-scope evaluation (3-day canary + focused latency/accuracy tests) from Red team's side so internal Eng can start while PO is pending.
  2) Provide 4 hours/week of engineering office hours for Free during the pilot window to accelerate integration.
  3) Offer a one-month usage credit or accelerated billing start upon PO signing as a commercial concession to keep momentum.
  4) If PO not in hand by Aug 12, escalate to CRO for priority review and potential exec alignment.

I've drafted SOW language to support a scoped delivery (SOW_Draft_v2.docx). If we want to present the concession package to Acme we should get approval from revenue ops.

-Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP adjustment request — proposed re-baseline + canary plan

Sarah / Procurement —

Appreciate the update, Sarah. To keep this operational and avoid a downstream escalation, here is a pragmatic re-baseline we can agree on now (subject to your procurement ETA):

Proposed re-baseline (short list):
- Aug 5: Acme delivers SOC2 evidence & architecture notes (or updated ETA).
- Aug 9: Start of scoped canary (3 business days): Redwood provides canary tokens/engineering hours.
- Aug 16: Pilot completion report (latency/accuracy metrics).
- Aug 23: Final commercial sign-off and PO execution target (sliding window depending on procurement).

If procurement can commit to a PO ETA by Aug 5 we will keep Aug 23 as target close; if not, we agree to escalate on Aug 12.

Commercial concession proposal (so we can keep momentum):
- One-month usage credit applied at invoice start OR 30% discount on first month for the pilot usage (your preference).
- Engineering office hours (as Marcus outlined).

Please confirm by COB Thu (Aug 5). If I don't hear back, I'll escalate per our internal playbook on Aug 6.

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP adjustment request — proposed re-baseline + canary plan

Ava / team —

Confirmed: procurement will target PO execution week of Aug 23; security managed to deliver SOC2 excerpts and architecture notes today (attached). Acme is comfortable moving forward with the narrowed evaluation scope you proposed.

We accept the one-month credit as our preferred concession. Please send the updated MAP and SOW for signature (procurement prefers DocuSign). I'll route to our legal and procurement for expedited review.

Next steps: 
- Ava: please upload revised MAP & SOW to DocuSign and share link.
- Marcus / Diego: be on standby Aug 9 for canary kickoff (3 days).

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting this across the line.

Sarah Liu
Director, AI Platforms | Acme Corporation
Attachments: Procurement_PO_Intent.pdf, SOC2_excerpt.pdf
